verdict.rationale: Apify's first-party docs describe webhooks that carry out an action, such as an HTTP request to another service or starting another Actor, when a system event occurs like an Actor run finishing or failing. Schedules and alerting add time-based and monitoring triggers. Together these deliver the core of event-triggered automation. Missing for 10: documented detail on rule conditions or filtering beyond event type, the breadth of supported event types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
